quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.description: Get your now-playing overlay into OBS in three steps

theme.title: Install or import a theme
theme.desc: The default theme works out of the box. To change the look, install one from the Store or import your own via Git or ZIP on the Themes page. Switching updates the live output instantly, no restart needed.

connect.title: Connect to OBS
connect.desc: smtc2web serves the overlay locally. Add it to OBS as a Browser source.
connect.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select and copy the URL manually.
connect.previewFailed: Couldn't open the browser. Please copy the URL manually.
connect.obsStep1: Add a new Browser source in OBS
connect.obsStep2: Paste the URL above into the URL field
connect.obsStep3: Set the size you need (e.g. 1920 × 1080) and click OK

ready.title: You're all set
ready.desc: Play some music and the overlay will show up in OBS.
ready.tip1: Track info is read automatically when music plays
ready.tip2: Themes switch live and the output refreshes immediately
ready.tip3: Port, listen address and process filter can be changed in Settings
